name: Prof. Azadeh Mansouri, Ph.D.
title: Associate Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering
tags: Director, Multimedia Security & Image Processing Lab
quote: “Digital media integrity is paramount in the modern era. True innovation emerges when robust image processing techniques meet accountable and secure multimedia systems.”
bio: Azadeh Mansouri is an Associate Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering. For over fifteen years, her research has bridged intelligent signal processing, digital watermarking, and applied computer vision.

Her laboratory formulates robust algorithms for image super-resolution, compressed domain video watermarking, and AI-generated content quality assessment, ensuring the authenticity and fidelity of digital media across critical deployments.

highlights.description: Delivered the opening plenary session on provably robust video watermarking and AI-generated content assessment. Accompanying slides, formal proofs, and seminar video are now archived in the open lab repo.

philosophy.title: Laboratory Philosophy
philosophy.description: Our group operates under the conviction that digital media processing must be governed by robust algorithmic design and empirical validation, ensuring both fidelity and security.
